users.zh: 希望认识眼前或耳边鸟类的新手及观鸟者。[M1]
users.en: Beginners and birdwatchers seeking help with a bird they see or hear. [M1]

scene.zh: 观鸟中识别，观鸟前后查看鸟种资料。[M1]
scene.en: Identify in the field and explore species before or after an encounter. [M1]

core.zh: 照片识别；声音识别；鸟种资料与个人清单。[M1, M3]
core.en: Photo ID; Sound ID; species exploration and a personal list. [M1, M3]

flow.zh: 照片路线归纳为4阶段：提供照片及背景信息 → 比较候选 → 选择鸟种 → 确认日期地点并保存。属于文档归纳，不是点击次数实测。[M1, M3]
flow.en: Photo route in 4 documented task stages: provide photo/context; compare candidates; select a bird; confirm date/place and save. These are reconstructed stages, not measured taps. [M1, M3]

data.zh: 识别模型与鸟种资料，eBird 记录为地区候选提供依据。[M1, M2]
data.en: Identification models and reference material, with eBird observations informing locally likely species. [M1, M2]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：多个识别入口与资料对照衔接清楚，适合学习；官网说明照片和声音识别可离线使用。[M1]
strength.en: Our assessment: several identification routes connect naturally to learning; the official overview documents offline photo and sound identification. [M1]

limits.zh: 声音覆盖有地区限制，不能把全球鸟种资料覆盖理解为全球声音识别覆盖。保存观察需要网络；私人保存已经存在。[M2, M3]
limits.en: Sound coverage is region-dependent. A global guide does not imply global Sound ID. Saving a sighting requires a connection; saved personal sightings are already private. [M2, M3]

borrow.zh: 候选对照、资料入口和选择后的确认步骤。我们的实现应允许待鉴定保存，不强迫用户选一个鸟名。
borrow.en: Candidate comparison, reference access and confirmation. Our design should also let an uncertain user keep evidence without choosing a species.

opportunity.zh: 可测试待鉴定记录与分用途发布的连贯性。照片识别、声音识别、私人清单本身都不是我们的独有功能。
opportunity.en: Test how well unresolved records and separately chosen sharing destinations work together. Photo ID, Sound ID and private lists are established features.

category.zh: 国内鸟类识别与个人资料

users.zh: 需要中文鸟名、识别和个人鸟类资料的观鸟者，为我们根据产品描述推断的受众。[D1]
users.en: Birdwatchers seeking Chinese names, identification and personal bird records; audience inferred from the product description. [D1]

scene.zh: 野外识别与事后整理个人资料。[D1]
scene.en: Field identification and later review of personal material. [D1]

core.zh: 离线图片及声音识别；鸟类资料；私人媒体库与成就清单。[D1]
core.en: Offline photo/audio ID; species reference; private media and a life list. [D1]

flow.zh: 仅作3阶段任务示意：提供素材 → 查看识别及资料 → 整理个人媒体。公开介绍不足以确定实际界面顺序，需另测小程序。
flow.en: A 3-stage analytical outline only: provide evidence; inspect identification/reference; organize personal media. Published descriptions do not establish the actual screen sequence.

data.zh: 产品介绍列出识别能力、鸟类资料，以及从 eBird、记录中心等导入个人清单的能力；本次不核定其训练数据。[D1]
data.en: The developer describes recognition, species reference and list imports from eBird and China Bird Report. Training-data composition is not established here. [D1]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：它是更直接的国内对照，已有识别、中文资料与私人积累，调研应同时纳入国内产品。
strength.en: Our assessment: a direct domestic comparator already combines identification, Chinese reference and personal accumulation.

limits.zh: iPhone 描述称其为懂鸟小程序的离线版本；App 与小程序功能一致性及本地识别表现需实测。[D1]
limits.en: The iPhone description calls it an offline version of the mini-program. App/mini-program parity and local recognition performance need testing. [D1]

borrow.zh: 鸟名表达一致、识别旁边可查资料，以及私人素材便于回看。
borrow.en: Consistent bird naming, reference beside identification and easy retrieval of personal evidence.

opportunity.zh: 测试校园日常观察、相似种复核和分享控制是否足够顺畅。中文、微信入口或多模态识别不能单独作为独有卖点。
opportunity.en: Test the campus encounter, candidate review and sharing controls. Chinese, WeChat access and multiple input modes alone are not unique positioning.

users.zh: 想知道鸟鸣来自哪种鸟的用户，以及愿意提交录音的观察者。[B1]
users.en: People identifying bird sounds and observers contributing recordings. [B1]

scene.zh: 观鸟中录音并检查建议鸟种。[B1]
scene.en: Record in the field and inspect suggested species. [B1]

core.zh: 声音采集；候选及分数；可选提交观察。[B1]
core.en: Audio capture; species suggestions and scores; optional observation contribution. [B1]

flow.zh: 官方列出4阶段：录音 → 分析 → 候选建议 → 可选贡献。这是任务阶段，不等于4次点击。[B1]
flow.en: The official page describes 4 stages: record; analyze; receive suggestions; optionally contribute. This is not a four-tap measurement. [B1]

data.zh: 用户录音与 BirdNET 神经网络；网站说明位置是可选信息。[B1]
data.en: User recordings and the BirdNET neural network; the project page describes location as optional. [B1]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：单一声音任务容易聚焦，适合作为录制、回听和候选呈现的对照。
strength.en: Our assessment: the focused audio task is a useful reference for recording, replay and result review.

limits.zh: 项目页与商店介绍的覆盖口径不同，不能混用为某个已安装版本的能力。App、Live、Analyzer 分开看；噪声及本地鸟种表现未实测。[B1, B2]
limits.en: Project and store pages use different coverage descriptions. Do not transfer these to a particular installed version, or conflate App, Live and Analyzer. Noise and local species remain untested. [B1, B2]

borrow.zh: 录制状态、回听、分析中的反馈，以及结果可以复查。分数应带模型来源与含义，不能直接写成正确概率。
borrow.en: Visible recording state, replay, analysis feedback and revisitable results. Label score source and meaning rather than displaying an unvalidated correctness probability.

opportunity.zh: 把录音及原始候选长期关联到自己的观察，允许后来更正鸟名；识别失败也能保留素材。
opportunity.en: Keep recordings and original suggestions linked to personal observations, permit later corrections and retain evidence after recognition failure.

users.zh: 记录所见所闻、查找观鸟地点并贡献观测数据的鸟友。[E1, E2]
users.en: Birdwatchers keeping records, finding places and contributing observation data. [E1, E2]

scene.zh: 观鸟前找地点，观鸟中记清单，结束后提交与回看。[E1, E2]
scene.en: Explore before an outing, keep a checklist during it and review afterwards. [E1, E2]

core.zh: 观察清单；区域和热点探索；个人观察统计。[E1, E2]
core.en: Checklists; regional/hotspot exploration; personal observation summaries. [E1, E2]

flow.zh: 已配置后的清单任务归纳为4阶段：开始观察并记鸟种数量 → 确认地点 → 结束并检查过程信息 → 提交。首次账号及鸟包配置另算。[E1]
flow.en: A configured checklist task in 4 stages: start and enter species/counts; confirm place; stop and review effort; submit. Account and pack setup are separate. [E1]

data.zh: 鸟友清单；探索工具同时关联 Macaulay Library 媒体与 Merlin 资料。[E1, E2]
data.en: Community checklists; Explore also connects Macaulay Library media and Merlin identification material. [E1, E2]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：把鸟种与观察地点、时间和观察过程放在一起，比只有鸟名更适合回顾一次活动。
strength.en: Our assessment: linking species to place, time and effort makes a visit more interpretable than a list of names alone.

limits.zh: 完整清单和过程信息可能需要新手解释，这是待测假设。官方说明未提交清单可留在手机，但不等于已同步到账号。[E1]
limits.en: Completeness and effort may need beginner guidance, a hypothesis to test. Unsubmitted lists can remain on the phone; that is not account synchronization. [E1]

borrow.zh: 观察时间与上传时间分开、历史鸟讯标日期、清楚区分手机草稿与已同步记录。
borrow.en: Separate observation/upload time, date historical sightings and distinguish a device draft from a synchronized record.

opportunity.zh: 以轻量私人观察为入口，再选择补全资料和发布。热点地图和鸟种统计已有成熟先例，不宜当作独有能力。
opportunity.en: Start with a small private encounter, then offer completion and sharing. Hotspot maps and species totals already have strong precedents.

users.zh: 记录自然、向他人求助或协助鉴定的人，范围不限于鸟类。[I1, I2]
users.en: Nature observers seeking or providing identification help, beyond birds. [I1, I2]

scene.zh: 记录一次遇见，之后查看建议、讨论和鉴定变化。[I1]
scene.en: Document an encounter and follow later suggestions, discussion and identifications. [I1]

core.zh: 带素材的观察；AI 候选对照；社区鉴定和讨论。[I1, I2]
core.en: Evidence-bearing observations; AI match comparison; community identification and discussion. [I1, I2]

flow.zh: 新 iPhone AI 相机路线归纳为5阶段：拍摄 → 检查匹配 → 保存到本机 → 可选编辑上传 → 查看后续鉴定。文档明确保存与上传不同。[I1]
flow.en: New iPhone AI-camera route in 5 stages: capture; review matches; save locally; optionally edit/upload; follow identifications. Saving and uploading are explicitly distinct. [I1]

data.zh: 用户观察和鉴定形成社区资料，识别模型也使用社区确认的观察。[I2, I4]
data.en: User observations and identifications build the community record; recognition models draw on community-verified observations. [I2, I4]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：候选与社区鉴定可持续复核。质量状态有规则，不能把选中 AI 候选直接算作专家确认。[I3]
strength.en: Our assessment: candidates and community identifications can be revisited. Quality grades have rules; choosing an AI suggestion is not expert verification. [I3]

limits.zh: 已上传的观察为公开记录，隐藏位置不等于隐藏整个观察；新 App 可保留尚未上传的本机记录。不要据旧描述断言它完全不能私人保存。[I1, I5]
limits.en: Uploaded observations are public; hiding coordinates does not hide the observation. The newer app can retain unuploaded local records, so it is inaccurate to say private saving is entirely absent. [I1, I5]

borrow.zh: 原始素材、AI 候选、用户选择与社区意见分开；清楚说明整条记录的可见性和地点可见性。
borrow.en: Separate raw evidence, model candidates, user choice and community input; explain record visibility separately from location visibility.

opportunity.zh: 测试私人收藏、地图贡献和论坛帖子的独立控制是否易理解。私人保存与相似种对照都不能直接宣称为首创。
opportunity.en: Test understandable independent controls for collections, map contributions and forum posts. Private saving and match comparison are not novel by themselves.

users.zh: 在中国提交、查询观察记录的鸟友。[C1, C2]
users.en: Birdwatchers submitting and querying observations in China. [C1, C2]

scene.zh: 观鸟前查记录，观鸟中后整理并提交本人观察。[C1, C2]
scene.en: Look up reports and document personal observations during or after an outing. [C1, C2]

core.zh: 观察记录提交；地区及鸟种查询；观察统计。[C1]
core.en: Observation reports; region/species queries; observation statistics. [C1]

flow.zh: 依据提交规则归纳4阶段：确定日期地点 → 填写本人鸟种与数量 → 添加或后补证据 → 检查提交。这是任务分析，小程序屏幕与点击次数待实测。[C2]
flow.en: A 4-stage outline from submission rules: establish date/place; enter personal species/counts; add or later supplement evidence; review/submit. Mini-program screens and taps remain unmeasured. [C2]

data.zh: 用户本人实际所见或所闻的记录及对应时间地点的素材。[C2]
data.en: Users’ own seen/heard observations and evidence from the matching encounter. [C2]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：国内记录规则直接相关，官网也提供微信小程序入口或说明。[C1]
strength.en: Our assessment: domestic recording rules are directly relevant; the official site also provides WeChat mini-program access or guidance. [C1]

limits.zh: 网站规则不等于小程序的逐屏功能清单。小程序导航、权限、失败恢复及私人整理能力需要现场走查。
limits.en: Website rules are not a screen-by-screen specification of the mini-program. Navigation, permissions, error recovery and private organization need a walkthrough.

borrow.zh: 本人观察与他人素材分开、允许后补证据、解释观察地点及日期、重视常见鸟记录。[C2]
borrow.en: Separate personal observations from others’ media, allow later evidence and explain date/place; ordinary species records also matter. [C2]

opportunity.zh: 验证新手的快速待鉴定记录，再补全和分享是否更顺畅。国内记录平台及微信入口已经存在。
opportunity.en: Test quick unresolved capture followed by completion and sharing. Domestic record platforms and a WeChat entry point already exist.

users.zh: 拍摄后需筛选大量照片的鸟类摄影者，是 Issue 4 明确点名的产品。[S1, S2]
users.en: Bird photographers sorting large batches after shooting; explicitly named in issue 4. [S1, S2]

scene.zh: 观鸟后对照片进行初筛、对比和整理。[S2]
scene.en: Post-outing photo selection, comparison and organization. [S2]

core.zh: 鸟类照片质量建议；连拍分组；筛选、对比和人工改星。[S1, S3]
core.en: Bird-photo quality suggestions; burst grouping; filtering, comparison and manual rating. [S1, S3]

flow.zh: 4阶段归纳：选照片目录 → 设置并运行分析 → 查看分组和评分 → 复核并整理结果。未安装计时或测量点击数。[S2, S3]
flow.en: A 4-stage reconstruction: select a folder; configure/run analysis; inspect groups/ratings; review and organize results. No installed timing or tap measurement. [S2, S3]

data.zh: 用户照片、图像模型与相机信息；罕见度另来自 GBIF 记录衍生指标，与保护等级不同。[S1, S2, S4]
data.en: User images, vision models and camera information; a GBIF-derived rarity indicator is separate from conservation status. [S1, S2, S4]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：围绕头部清晰度和连拍复核，解决拍后选片的具体问题；自动建议保留人工选择空间。[S2, S3]
strength.en: Our assessment: head sharpness and burst review address a concrete post-shoot task while retaining manual selection. [S2, S3]

limits.zh: 官网为桌面产品；本次流程依据 4.5.0 教程，首页显示更新版本。文件夹、RAW 和元数据操作不能直接照搬到微信小程序。[S1, S2]
limits.en: This is desktop software. Workflow evidence uses the 4.5.0 guide while the homepage advertises a newer release. Folder, RAW and metadata operations need separate mini-program feasibility work. [S1, S2]

borrow.zh: 后续可做同次观察多图对比和代表图选择，显示建议原因并允许改选。首版避免自动移动或删除用户原片。
borrow.en: Later compare photos within an encounter and select a representative, explain suggestions and allow changes. Avoid automatic original-file moves or deletion in the first release.

opportunity.zh: 把少量素材与观察关联；批量选片保留 PHOTO-01 候选。资料中的罕见度指标不能直接当作成长奖励依据。
opportunity.en: Link a small evidence set to an encounter. Keep batch culling in PHOTO-01. A documented rarity indicator is not a ready-made basis for growth rewards.

users.zh: 刚开始探索自然的人与家庭。[K1, K2]
users.en: Beginners exploring nature and families. [K1, K2]

scene.zh: 边探索边认识生物，之后回看收集与挑战进度。[K1, K2]
scene.en: Recognize organisms while exploring and revisit collection/challenge progress. [K1, K2]

core.zh: 相机即时识别；本机观察积累；徽章与挑战。[K1, K2]
core.en: Live camera identification; local observations; badges and challenges. [K1, K2]

flow.zh: 4阶段任务归纳：打开相机 → 查看识别 → 加入观察 → 查看成长反馈。此为文档归纳，具体徽章触发与点击数待实测。[K1, K2]
flow.en: A 4-stage task outline: open camera; inspect identification; add an observation; see progress. Badge triggers and exact taps need testing. [K1, K2]

data.zh: 模型基于 iNaturalist 及合作站点的社区资料；通常使用的本机模型可能比在线模型旧。[K1, K2]
data.en: Models draw on iNaturalist/partner community data; the local model is generally older than the online one. [K1, K2]

strength.zh: 我们的判断：成长反馈可以服务自然学习，不必依赖公开发帖；官方说明普通使用无需账号。[K2]
strength.en: Our assessment: progress can support learning without requiring public posting; ordinary use does not require an account. [K2]

limits.zh: 本机 AI 结果不等于社区复核。普通本机使用与可选登录发布到 iNaturalist 要分开说明。[K2]
limits.en: Local AI output is not community review. Distinguish ordinary device-local use from optional sign-in and posting to iNaturalist. [K2]

borrow.zh: 成长反馈可独立于社交分享。我们的后续规则应允许常见鸟和待鉴定观察产生学习价值。
borrow.en: Keep progress independent of social sharing. Our future rules can value ordinary birds and learning from unresolved encounters.

opportunity.zh: 测试记录笔记、补充线索和学习相似种后获得庭院装饰。保留 BADGE-01 候选，不把追稀有鸟或公开精确地点设为奖励条件。
opportunity.en: Test garden decorations for notes, added evidence and learning similar species. Keep BADGE-01 optional; do not require rare-species chasing or exact-location publication.

decisions: R1
保留候选比较和待鉴定保存。
Keep candidate comparison and unresolved saving.
用户应能看参考说明、保留原始建议，再选择或更正鸟名。模型分数与用户选择各自保存；跨来源不直接平均分数。
Users should inspect references, retain original suggestions and choose or correct a label. Store scores independently from user choice; do not average unrelated sources.
R2
MAP-01 / MAP-02
地图优先展示可解释的历史观察。
Show interpretable dated observations on the map.
显示观察日期与地点信息，保持地图、详情和返回后的视口一致。真实地图服务接入仍需 Issue 5；历史记录不能包装成鸟仍在现场。
Show observation date/place and preserve map/detail context. The real provider still depends on issue 5; a historical sighting is not a live bird location.
R3
验证私人保存与公开用途的独立控制。
Validate private saving and independent public uses.
私人观察、收藏、地图贡献和论坛帖子各自显示状态。公开前预览包含哪些字段；隐藏位置和隐藏整条记录分别解释。
Expose distinct states for private observations, collections, map contributions and forum posts. Preview published fields; distinguish location privacy from whole-record visibility.
R4
REF-01 / DATA-01 / G10
参考检索、复核和模型训练分开决策。
Decide reference retrieval, review and model training separately.
外部资料可查不代表素材可复用。保留来源、授权和复核状态；用户选中的标签不能直接升级为已复核样本。真实接入另行验收。
Accessible reference material is not automatically reusable media. Retain provenance, permission and review state. A selected label is not a reviewed example; test real integrations separately.
R5
PHOTO-01
批量选片保持候选范围。
Keep batch photo culling in the candidate backlog.
可先评估同一次观察的少量图片对比、代表图选择。大批 RAW、目录移动和元数据写回需要单独验证，不计入当前原型已实现。

First evaluate comparing a small evidence set and choosing a representative. Bulk RAW, folder moves and metadata writes need separate feasibility work and are not implemented in the current prototype.
R6
BADGE-01
成长先验证学习反馈，再考虑扩展小游戏。
Validate learning feedback before expanding the mini-game.
可提议完成笔记、补充线索、学习相似种后获得羽叶或庭院装饰。奖励与公开分享分开；规则应处理重复提交和撤回。识别正确率或留存提升均尚未验证。

Propose feathers/leaves or garden decorations for notes, added clues and learning similar species. Keep rewards separate from publishing and handle duplicates/withdrawals. No accuracy or retention improvement has been demonstrated.
tests: 让目标用户从地图找到一条有日期的记录，打开并返回；检查是否误以为鸟仍在原地。
Ask a target user to open a dated map record and return; check whether they assume the bird is still there.
提供模糊图片或无可靠声音候选，观察用户能否保存待鉴定、补充素材并再次找到它。
Provide an unclear image or unreliable sound result; observe unresolved saving, evidence addition and later retrieval.
展示来自不同来源的建议，询问用户是否将分数理解为正确概率，以及分歧后如何选择。
Show suggestions from different sources; ask whether scores imply correctness probability and what the user does after disagreement.
先保存私人记录，再仅选择一个渠道发布，询问谁能看到哪些字段；撤回后再次检查。
Save privately, publish to one destination, ask who can see which fields, then withdraw and check again.

zh: 已有产品分别覆盖识别、私人清单、地图鸟讯、社区鉴定和拍后选片。我们建议先验证一条完整的小程序流程：探索地点，保留本人观察素材，复核候选，再分别选择收藏与公开用途。单个常见功能及中文、微信入口，都不足以说明产品具有独特优势。
本调研对应 Issue 4 的九个维度，保留国内对照并增加成长参考，共比较8个产品，覆盖题目建议的5类对象。目标是帮助收敛需求与原型，不在本阶段承诺批量选片或游戏首发。
资料核验日期为2026年10月23日。功能以官网、官方帮助和开发者商店说明为依据；“我们的判断”、可借鉴点与差异机会属于设计分析。流程数字表示归纳后的任务阶段，首次配置另算；本次未安装并实测竞品，不能用阶段数做点击数、速度或易用性排名。
en: Existing products already cover identification, private lists, map sightings, community identification and photo culling. We propose validating one coherent mini-program journey: explore a place, retain personal evidence, review candidates and separately choose collection and public uses. Individual features, Chinese support and WeChat access do not establish uniqueness.

This review follows the nine dimensions in issue 4. It retains domestic comparisons and adds a growth reference: 8 products cover the 5 suggested categories. The purpose is to narrow requirements and prototype choices, without committing batch culling or a game to the first release.

Sources were checked on 23 October 2026. Features come from official sites, help pages and developer listings. Assessments, borrowing ideas and possible differences are design analysis. Workflow numbers count reconstructed task stages, excluding initial setup; apps were not installed or timed, so these are not tap counts or usability rankings.

zh: 尚未实测中国大陆网络可用性、微信内权限、端侧或服务端推理速度、目标鸟种准确率、耗电和存储开销。官网功能描述不能替代这些结果。
部分页面存在版本差异：BirdNET 项目页与商店的覆盖描述不同；慧眼选鸟首页版本新于所引用教程。只引用对应界面的明确行为，不合并覆盖数或跨版本保证。
eBird 部分主站页面出现自动访问限制，本报告采用可读取的官方帮助说明；懂鸟主站未提供可读正文，具体功能以开发者商店描述为依据。未取得的小程序走查结果不补写为事实。
en: Mainland network availability, WeChat permissions, inference latency, target-species accuracy, battery and storage were not measured. Published feature descriptions do not establish those results.

Version differences matter: BirdNET project/store coverage descriptions differ; the SuperPicky landing page is newer than the cited tutorial. Do not merge coverage totals or transfer guarantees across interfaces or versions.

Some eBird main-site pages restricted automated retrieval, so accessible official help supplies the workflow evidence. Dongniao’s main page yielded no readable body; feature claims rely on its developer listing. Unperformed mini-program walkthroughs remain open.
